- `WeightedGraph` no longer exposes an `Edge[]` factory; graph construction now goes through `List<Edge>` or raw `int[][]` only, which simplifies the boundary. See [WeightedGraph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/WeightedGraph.java#L4).
